text:
devin: quick heads up — infra is rotating the prod CMK next week. any SIEM exports encrypted with the old key will need rewrap before external delivery.

audit-bot: key-rotation ticket KR-907 created for 2026-04-05T02:00Z; impacted objects flagged.

sara-sec: we should never rely on old presigned links surviving a key rotation. suggest automated rewrap + new audit event + JIT vendor delivery. block raw handoffs.

tom-oncall: what happens to currently issued presigned URLs? do they silently 403?

devin: presigned URIs validate against the object version and encryption. rewrapping creates a new ciphertext -> old presigned will 403. we need to notify any active external leases and plan re-issue if appropriate.

irene-privacy: also need to check retention classifications: Forensic exports live in forensic-retain (180d) but vendor deliverables must be ephemeral. if vendor asks for historical data, require a fresh JIT export and legal sign-off.

sara-sec: proposed workflow: 1) disable direct raw exports to external principals 2) create ephemeral snapshot in ephemeral-exports/INC-XXXX/ 3) run scrubber (PII rules) -> output redacted file 4) rewrap with new CMK 5) generate presigned GET limited to vendor principal + 24h TTL 6) emit audit event tag=key-rotation-rewrap and link to ticket.

devin: sample commands for automation (dry-run):
```
# create SIEM export snapshot
redwood-siem export create --query "host:db-1 OR host:web-3" --since 2026-03-01T00:00Z --until 2026-03-01T06:00Z --dest s3://ephemeral-exports/kr907/dryrun/ --encrypt-with cmk-old-key --ttl 24h

# rewrap object to new CMK (AWS CLI example)
aws s3 cp s3://ephemeral-exports/kr907/dryrun/obj.gz - | aws s3 cp - s3://ephemeral-exports/kr907/dryrun/rewrapped-obj.gz --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/cmk-new-key
```

sara-sec: scrubber must run before rewrap. minimal regexes: mask emails, long ids, cc-like patterns, and strip env vars from proc args. output must include scrubber report attached to the ticket.

tom-oncall: approval chain: sec-lead + privacy + oncall. annotate ticket with 'key-rotation-affected' and add timeline. no exec approval required for normal triage scope per policy.

audit-bot: approval requested by sara-sec at 1717001400.

irene-privacy: I can pre-approve for vuln triage only if scrubber report shows no customer PII. legal will review anything with customer identifiers.

devin: I'll add automation: any vendor-s3 prefix older than 7d gets auto-expunged and an alert created. also enable KMS key access logging for the rewrap window.

tom-oncall: plan sounds good. i'll run a dry-run rewrap after KR test and report results. add test to runbook to verify presigned URL behavior post-rotation.

sara-sec: don't forget to update SIEM export docs and the runbook steps for obtaining a fresh JIT export when keys rotate.

devin: thanks all :thumbsup:
